versions.changelog:
- Added detailed usage instructions for synthesising speech and generating text-to-speech (TTS) audio with Google Gemini via yummycli.
- Supports single-speaker narration, multi-speaker dialogue (up to 2 speakers), and listing available voices.
- Outlines model and voice selection rules, including mapping user requests to TTS models and prebuilt voice styles.
- Documents command syntax, flag behavior, and strict execution/validation rules.
- Includes example commands and clarifies output formats and error-handling procedures.
